name: 129.1 — the four comments say what the mechanism does
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 129.1: Refusal.MOVED and Refusal.KEYS carry no rows, so a retired section name and a dotted verb read plain nil and a retired event key meets the emitter's own generic refusal -- while a live section, a live colon verb and a live key still answer, the one table that does carry rows still fires, and a closed vocabulary still throws.
